submission.implementation_notes: Revision 2 of the scenario (thread token): one script that runs as a minting policy for the token and as a spending validator for the funds, and reads its own hash from the script context. Hand-written validator: typed `PlutusLedgerApi.Data.V3` matching and a derived single-field `EscrowDatum`, with mint entries and the deposit datum compared by `Data` equality. Compiled with Plinth (PlutusTx) 1.45.0.0, targeting Plutus Core 1.1.0 and Plutus V3. This row holds the reference text of the plain family; the 1.61 and 1.64 plain rows and the two `_asdata` rows compile the same validator text.
